title: vibestackr run-local config
description: Describes the local dev stack vibestackr should bring up: services, their dependency order, liveness checks, env, warnings, and keyboard shortcuts. Accepted as .vibestackr.json, .vibestackr, .vibestackr.yaml, or .vibestackr.yml in the project root, or via --config <path>.

name.description: Brand shown in the corner of the TUI and as the terminal title. Defaults to 'run-local'.

services.description: One entry per process vibestackr manages.

dependencies.description: Checks run before startup; each reports its message and aborts startup if every condition in `when` is true.

warnings.description: Non-fatal messages printed at startup when every condition in `when` is true (or always, if `when` is omitted).

service.description: Prefixes the message with '<service>: ' and is skipped entirely if that service is excluded from the run.

shortcuts.description: Single-key actions available while the TUI is running.

name.description: Unique identifier — used as the tab name, in --exclude/--only, and in dependsOn/restart references.

type.description: Free-form label. 'node' additionally triggers an automatic `npm install` on first run if cwd/node_modules is missing.

cwd.description: Working directory the command runs in, relative to the project root.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged over process.env for this service only.

note.description: One-line description shown pinned atop the service's log tab and in its startup log line — e.g. the URL it serves on.

oneShot.description: True for a job that's expected to exit (a build, a migration, a docker-run) rather than a long-running server.

watcher.description: True if this service auto-restarts/reloads itself on file changes (e.g. nodemon, vite/webpack HMR, spring-boot devtools). Purely informational — vibestackr doesn't implement the watching itself, just surfaces the fact (e.g. via the get_services MCP tool).

dependsOn.description: Other service names that must be ready before this one starts.

onSuccess.description: Shell command run once this oneShot service's process exits with code 0. Fires on process exit, not on liveness passing.

onReady.description: Shell command run once this service is actually ready (liveness passed, or process exited if oneShot with no liveness). Skipped if liveness times out or fails.

jsonLog.description: Reformats this service's output for display when a line parses as a single JSON object (e.g. Spring Boot's logback JSON encoder, or a pino/winston JSON logger) — everything else is shown unchanged. Purely a display concern: the raw line is still what's captured in the log buffer / --persist-logs file.

format.description: Template built from the parsed JSON fields, e.g. '${time} [${level}] ${message}'. ${field} supports dot-path for nested fields (${context.requestId}) and ${field:-default}.

levelField.description: Field holding the log level, used to color the whole formatted line (case-insensitive: error/fatal/severe=red, warn/warning=yellow, debug/trace=grey, anything else uncolored). Defaults to 'level'.

colors.description: Overrides/extends the default level-to-color mapping, e.g. { "notice": "cyan" }.

liveness.description: How vibestackr decides a service is ready.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before marking the service 'timeout'. Default 300.

command.description: Shell command; exit code 0 means ready.

condition.description: A single condition; a check/warning fires only when every condition in its `when` list evaluates true.

key.description: Single key that triggers this shortcut, e.g. 'r', 'g'.

label.description: Shown in the status bar legend and --help output.

restart.description: Name of a service to restart (or start, if not already running).

command.description: Shell command to run. Mutually exclusive with `restart`.

cwd.description: Working directory for `command`, relative to the project root.
